$comment: One run of the scripted generation pipeline (docs/generation-flow.md) on a fixed prompt, used as the baseline for later phases of the pipeline work. It measures the Phase 1 flow (honest validate, typecheck gate, docs/compact-gotchas.md + docs/patterns.md context budget), not the flow before Phase 1. Re-run the same prompt after each phase and add a run below. From Phase 3 the run is driven by `yarn pipeline`, and its gate counts come from examples/<name>/logs/pipeline.jsonl.
prompt: Build a private tip jar: people can leave tips for the jar's owner without revealing who tipped how much, and only the owner can withdraw.
scope: Steps 1-4: name and flags, new:example, contract + witnesses + tests, compile/typecheck, yarn validate. No UI.

runs.model: claude-opus-5-5, one general-purpose subagent given only the prompt and the flow doc

contracts: tip-token.compact (demo faucet so tests have shielded coins)

notes: typecheck: run before the tests were written; the scaffold's deployContract call lacked the new constructor argument. Phase 2's --derive would generate it.

largestReads: examples/shielded-chips/src/test/roulette.test.ts (32 KB, read in full: no 'Your tests begin here' marker)
beyondBudget: shielded-chips src/wallet.ts (splitShieldedCoin) and src/providers.ts: the template harness has no shielded self-transfer
context.notRead: LESSONS.md, TUTORIAL.md, midnight-expert skills, SDK sources
context.comparison: The pre-Phase-1 step 3 reading list was about 330 KB.

reviewNotes: Tip amounts are public (each pot entry is a full QualifiedShieldedCoinInfo); documented as an accepted leak. Who tipped is not recorded.

reNonceToSelf spends the same-transaction coin with sendShielded and mt_index 0, copied from shielded-chips roulette. docs/compact-gotchas.md (from the shielded-chips TUTORIAL) says same-transaction coins should use sendImmediateShielded. Both contracts pass on the devnet; worth a reviewer's eye.
Negative check of the new validate on this example: one broken assertion made yarn validate exit 1 at test:local, write logs/compose.log and tear the network down.
phase2And3Signals: A shielded self-transfer helper and a shielded test faucet had to be ported or written by hand; candidates for packages/ or the template.
Test files without the 'Your tests begin here' marker are read in full; adding it to every example's test would cut the largest read.
Context read (~125 KB) is still dominated by one large reference test; patterns.md could point at narrower test slices.

runs.model: claude-opus-5-5, one general-purpose subagent given only the prompt and the flow doc, in the main checkout (example name tip-jar-p2; the generated code was not committed)

result.validate: pass on the first devnet run, 10/10 tests
contracts: tip-jar-p2.compact (tip jar, plus a tipCount Counter)
tip-token.compact (demo faucet so the devnet test has shielded coins)

notes: typecheck (boilerplate): the agent gave createTipJarP2PrivateState a parameter (the owner secret); the scaffolded devnet test still called it with none. --derive filled constructor args but not the private-state factory call. Fixed after this run: the initialPrivateState/privateState lines are now a derived region (not yet measured).

context.breakdown: about 63 KB within the step budget, 11 KB beyond it, 21 KB of AGENTS.md injected automatically when touching an example directory
beyondBudget: private-tip-jar.test.ts above its marker (~6 KB): two-wallet setup and the tokenCoins/takeCoin/tokenBalance coin helpers the test body calls
private-tip-jar contract/index.ts and package.json scripts: wiring a second, witness-less contract
own src/wallet.ts and src/providers.ts signatures (~2 KB)
context.comparison: Phase 1 read about 125 KB, dominated by a 32 KB test without a marker.

comparisonWithPhase1.devnetRuns: 1 → 1; validate passed first time in both
comparisonWithPhase1.gateFailures: 1 → 1, both boilerplate (constructor args in Phase 1, fixed by --derive; the private-state factory call in Phase 2)
comparisonWithPhase1.note: One run each, so treat the differences as indicative. The logic was checked by test:sim (10 tests) before the devnet run, which Phase 1 could only do on the devnet.

reviewNotes: The design matched private-tip-jar closely (the agent read it as the nearest example), adding a tipCount Counter. Tip amounts are public and listed as an accepted leak.
Step 1 SPEC.md was not reviewed by a human (none available); the card says so.
phase3Signals: Shared devnet test helpers for shielded coins (two wallets, tokenCoins/takeCoin/tokenBalance, the mint-to-wallet faucet call) were ported by hand, about 130 lines: a template or package candidate, with the faucet contract.
--derive covers only the contract named after the example; the second (faucet) contract was wired by hand.
The SPEC template has no place for a test-only contract.
Root and example AGENTS.md (~21 KB) arrive automatically; the context budget should count them or they should shrink.
Example README.md and AGENTS.md TODO stubs are left unfilled; nothing gates on them.

runs.model: claude-opus-5-5, one general-purpose subagent given only the prompt and the flow doc, driving `yarn pipeline tip-jar-p3 --json`, in the main checkout (the generated code was not committed)
runs.scope: Steps 1-5 as before, plus the UI scaffold that the pipeline now creates once the in-memory gate passes. Step 6 (UI seed code) was not written, so the run ends when the background devnet is green.

result.validate: pass on the first devnet run, 10/10 tests (in the background)
result.testSim: 6/6 in memory, every assert in an expectRejects, 4 privacy keys
contracts: tip-jar-p3.compact (tip jar, plus a tipCount Counter)

timeline.devnetSteps: env:up 12.0 s, wait:dust 4.4 s, test:local 175.5 s
timeline.note: uiReady: the pipeline's next first pointed at the UI seed files (UI scaffolded, yarn install done, devnet started). In Phases 1 and 2 the UI could only start after the devnet passed, at the end of the run (633 s, 477 s).

notes: test:sim (boilerplate): the first entry to 3c ran the derived witness stub ('witness ownerSecretKey is not implemented'). next.read listed the gate-failure reading first; fixed after the run: an unimplemented stub now says 'implement the witness stubs' and the 3c reading comes first.

new:ui (pipeline bug): the source hash was taken before --derive, which then rewrote the devnet test's private-state region, so the sim stamp held a stale hash and new:ui refused. Fixed after the run: the hash is recomputed after derive (checked by planting an empty region in private-tip-jar: the stamp matches the post-derive sources).

context.breakdown: about 90 KB within the step budget (the private-tip-jar devnet test, 17 KB, read whole including the helpers above its marker, as the budget allows), about 22 KB of AGENTS.md injected automatically; beyond budget only a 3 KB diff of the template wallet/providers against private-tip-jar's, plus pipeline sources read to diagnose the new:ui refusal
context.comparison: Phase 2: ~95 KB. The flow doc grew from 12 KB to 20 KB with the pipeline sections.

comparisonWithPhase2.wallClock: 477 s → 442 s (−7%) to devnet green, with the UI scaffolded on top
comparisonWithPhase2.timeToUi: ≈477 s (after the devnet) → 185 s (the devnet still running)
comparisonWithPhase2.gateFailures: 1 → 2: one boilerplate (unimplemented witness stub on first entry to 3c), one pipeline bug (stale hash after derive), both fixed after the run
comparisonWithPhase2.note: One run each; the step-1 worked example (private-tip-jar) is exactly this prompt, so the design and much of the code were close to a port, which flatters every phase equally.

reviewNotes: Step 1's card passed spec:lint --file --witnesses first time and stood in for the human review (none available).

The in-memory gate let the devnet start on the scaffold's devnet test skeleton (deploy only, it.todo per circuit); the agent wrote the devnet test on its own initiative. Fixed after the run: the SPEC code checks require no it.todo in the devnet test and every transaction circuit called in it.
pipeline.jsonl did not log spec, spec:code or the devnet result; fixed after the run (the devnet result is logged once, with its step times, when the pipeline first sees the finished run).
new:example's next steps still told the agent to run compile:fast and validate by hand; they now lead with yarn pipeline.
phase4Signals: The shared shielded test faucet and coin helpers: the devnet test was again a port of private-tip-jar's (two wallets, mint, re-nonce).
--derive for the second (faucet) contract, wired by hand again.
A different prompt for the next baseline, since the worked example is this one.
The UI gates re-run on every pipeline call; a stamp over ui/ would skip them when nothing changed.
